title: Butcher Shop, Week 6
dek: Chase Brown is on bye with 22 carries for 49 in two weeks. That is the prime cut to buy.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Mon 4:35 PM ET: Bhayshul Tuten comes off the buy list. He had 12 of Jacksonville's 27 rushes vs HOU, 44 percent, after 22 of 24 back carries in Week 5, and Chris Rodriguez Jr. ran 11 times for 55. Hold him at RB18 rest of season for me until the Week 8 carry split.

Updated Mon 4:30 PM ET: Michael Wilson comes off the buy list: he was third on Arizona in targets vs LAR (7, behind Trey McBride's 9 and Kendrick Bourne's 8) and has 4 catches in both games without Marvin Harrison Jr.; hold him at WR40 rest of season. Tony Pollard comes off the sell list after 19 carries to Tyjae Spears' 1; hold him at RB30. Davante Adams hurt his left knee late Sunday, so wait for the MRI before selling. Brian Thomas Jr. was benched for the second half; still a sell, for a bench receiver.

Updated Sat 6:20 PM ET: added MarShawn Lloyd as a sell. Josh Jacobs is eligible again for Week 7, so sell Lloyd after his Sunday night game vs DAL.

Updated Wed 4:35 PM ET: Lamar Jackson did not practice Wednesday with the ankle; he is still QB2 rest of season for me, so trade for him before Friday's injury report and offer a WR2. Chase Brown ran 13 times for 38 @MIA and Cincinnati's coordinator is reviewing the split with Samaje Perine; he is still RB6 rest of season for me, a buy for an RB2 and a WR3.

Updated Tue 6:00 PM ET: Jaylen Warren comes off the sell list. Mike McCarthy called him Pittsburgh's featured player Monday and said his role will not change with Rico Dowdle getting healthy; hold him at RB23 rest of season for me.

Week 5 handed out touchdowns to backs who will lose their jobs and quiet days to players whose roles did not move. The buys are good usage with a lagging box score or a short injury scare; the sells scored on volume that is about to leave. Ranks are rest of season for me, PPR scoring, prices written for 12-team leagues.
outro_md: Heat Check has the usage trends behind these calls, and the Menu ranks every one of them for Week 6.

buy.why: Chase Brown (CIN) still out-snapped Samaje Perine 38 to 33 @MIA, but Perine ran 14 times for 68 while Brown went 13 for 38 and lost a fumble in the red zone. Brown has 22 carries for 48 over two games, and OC Dan Pitcher said the team will keep assessing how the touches split. Cincinnati is on bye in Week 6, so his manager stares at that number for two weeks.
buy.verdict: RB6 rest of season for me. Trade for him during the bye; offer an RB2 and a WR3.

buy.why: Chris Olave (NO) drew 13, 10 and 13 targets in Weeks 1 to 3 and scored 15 or more PPR points in each of the first four games. He caught 4 of 6 for 46 vs MIN with Tyler Shough throwing for 96 yards on a hurt left hand, and that one quiet game is the discount.
buy.verdict: WR7 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2.

buy.why: Trey McBride (ARI) drew 10 or more targets in each of his first four games, 46 in all, with 2 touchdowns on that volume. Marvin Harrison Jr. is gone to Houston, which takes one more mouth out of the Arizona passing game.
buy.verdict: TE2 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2.

buy.why: DJ Moore (BUF) drew a team-high 10 targets vs LAC in Week 3 while playing through the shoulder, then sat Monday night @LAR with an AC joint sprain that Adam Schefter reports is not long term. Keon Coleman caught 1 of 2 targets in his place, so the role is waiting for Moore.
buy.verdict: WR23 rest of season for me. Trade for him while he sits; offer a bench WR3.

buy.price: a WR3 and a bench RB
buy.why: Kyren Williams (LAR) played 72 percent of the snaps to Blake Corum's 28 vs ARI and had 13 touches, his season low: 10 of the 19 back carries for 50 and 3 catches for 17. Corum has scored in two straight weeks, and that is what keeps Williams' price down while the snaps stay his.
buy.verdict: RB12 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench RB.

buy.why: Rashee Rice (KC) saw his targets climb from 2 to 6 to 9 in Weeks 1 to 3, a 39 percent share in Week 3, before a hamstring Ian Rapoport called relatively minor. Tyquan Thornton is out 12 to 16 weeks after ankle surgery, so the targets in Kansas City are concentrating.
buy.verdict: WR20 rest of season for me. Trade for him before he practices; offer a WR3.

buy.price: a TE in the 10 to 14 range and a bench WR
buy.why: Colston Loveland (CHI) led Chicago with 9 targets in Week 4 with Tyson Bagent throwing, as many as he had in Weeks 1 to 3 combined. He caught 2 of 5 for 19 @GB with the backups in, and Caleb Williams is on track to practice Wednesday.
buy.verdict: TE4 rest of season for me. Trade for him before Williams is back; offer a TE in the 10 to 14 range and a bench WR.

buy.why: Lamar Jackson (BAL) sat Week 5 with the ankle while Tyler Huntley went 24 of 32 for 201 and won it in overtime @ATL. Jackson did not practice Wednesday and has not practiced since he got hurt Oct. 4, but Adam Schefter reports a realistic chance he plays @CLE. Jackson ran 6 times for 50 in Week 3.
buy.verdict: QB2 rest of season for me. Trade for him before Friday's injury report; offer a WR2.

buy.why: Mike Evans (SF) drew 10 targets @SEA and caught 7 for 113 and a TD while playing through two broken ribs. Deebo Samuel Sr. is out a few weeks with the hamstring, and San Francisco's Week 8 bye stretches that window.
buy.verdict: WR26 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3.

buy.why: Malik Nabers (NYG) drew 15 targets vs NO and caught 12 for 165, a week after 20 targets and 11 for 121 and a TD @WAS. Jameis Winston was benched in the fourth quarter and no Week 7 starter is named, and the targets have come no matter who throws.
buy.verdict: WR14 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2.

buy.why: Aaron Jones Sr. (MIN) played a season-high 87 percent of the snaps @NO and ran 25 times for 113 and a TD. Minnesota is on bye in Week 6, and Jordan Mason (thumb) is not eligible to come off IR until Week 7, so the price is low for a back with this role.
buy.verdict: RB32 rest of season for me. Trade for him during the bye; offer a bench RB.

sell.price: a WR3 with a full-time role
sell.why: Braelon Allen (NYJ) ran 24 times for 116 and a TD vs CLE with Breece Hall inactive a second week, and he took all 14 back carries in Week 4. Hall is week to week with the quad, and the job goes back to him when he is healthy.
sell.verdict: RB49 rest of season for me with Hall healthy. Trade him away after this week; ask for a WR3 with a full-time role.

sell.why: Javonte Williams (DAL) ran 12 times for 45 and a TD vs TB, and Dallas ran for 50 yards as a team. He has 74 carries at about 3.7 a carry, and the touchdowns are carrying the scoring.
sell.verdict: RB11 rest of season for me, and the touchdowns put his price above that. Trade him away; ask for a WR2.

sell.why: Davante Adams (LAR) caught 5 of 7 for 51 and 2 TDs vs BUF while Puka Nacua drew 24 targets. Adams drew 13 targets @DEN in Week 3 with Nacua out, and that volume left when Nacua came back. He then hurt his left knee without contact late vs ARI on Sunday and did not return; there is no diagnosis yet.
sell.verdict: WR25 rest of season for me. Wait for the MRI before you set a price; if it comes back clean, trade him away and ask for a WR2.

sell.why: Jaylen Waddle (DEN) has 10 catches for 66 yards in the four games outside Week 2. He ran a route on 82 percent of the dropbacks in Week 3 and drew 7 targets for 2 catches and 10 yards, behind Courtland Sutton in the pecking order.
sell.verdict: WR15 rest of season for me, and his name sells for more than his role. Trade him away; ask for a WR3 who gets targets.

sell.price: a bench WR with a full-time role
sell.why: Emanuel Wilson (SEA) has 41 carries in two games with Jadarian Price on IR and Zach Charbonnet on PUP, 20 for 61 and a TD vs SF. Charbonnet's activation is close, and Wilson ran for 3.1 a carry in Week 5.
sell.verdict: RB59 rest of season for me. Trade him away before Charbonnet is back; ask for a bench WR with a full-time role.

sell.why: Brian Thomas Jr. (JAX) was benched for the second half vs HOU after 15 snaps, with 0 catches on 2 targets for his second straight catchless game, and Liam Coen said players have to step up and make plays. Jacksonville is on bye in Week 7.
sell.verdict: WR42 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench receiver.

sell.why: Aaron Rodgers (PIT) has thrown 3 TDs in three straight games, but those were 22-point weeks, with 235 yards vs IND. Three of his receivers are out or on IR going to TB.
sell.verdict: QB29 rest of season for me. Trade him away while the touchdowns show; ask for a bench RB.

sell.price: a bench WR and a streaming QB
sell.why: Justin Herbert (LAC) threw for 121 yards vs DEN and has not had a 15-point game in five tries. He plays behind a line with one starter left from September, with Rashawn Slater on IR and Joe Alt hurt.
sell.verdict: QB16 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR and a streaming QB.

sell.price: a bench WR with a full-time role
sell.why: Jake Ferguson (DAL) scored 3 TDs on 11 targets in Weeks 1 to 3, then caught 3 of 6 for 19 vs TB. George Pickens and CeeDee Lamb take the volume, and Ferguson shares snaps with two other tight ends.
sell.verdict: TE17 rest of season for me. Trade him away on the touchdowns; ask for a bench WR with a full-time role.

sell.price: a bench WR with a weekly role
sell.why: MarShawn Lloyd (GB) scored twice on 10 carries vs CHI and had 42 percent of Green Bay's running back touches with Josh Jacobs on the Commissioner's Exempt List. Jacobs comes off the list Monday, is eligible for Week 7 and is expected to step back in as the starter.
sell.verdict: RB41 rest of season for me. Trade him away after Sunday night; ask for a bench WR with a weekly role.
